title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 19: Hezekiah's prayer, Isaiah's message about Sennacherib and the deliverance of Jerusalem.

questions.text: To whom did Hezekiah send Eliakim, Shebna and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth?
questions.explanation: He sent them to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

answers.text: Hilkiah the high priest of Yahweh
Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz

questions.text: According to Isaiah, what would Yahweh cause to happen to the king of Assyria in his own land?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would put a spirit in him, he would return to his own land, and Yahweh would cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

answers.text: He would fall by the sword
He would be eaten by lions
He would be taken captive to Egypt

questions.text: Against which city did Rabshakeh find the king of Assyria warring when he returned?
questions.explanation: Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he had departed from Lachish.

questions.text: Of which king did the king of Assyria hear that he had come out to fight against him?
questions.explanation: He heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, "Behold, he has come out to fight against you."

questions.text: What did Hezekiah do with the letter he received from the messengers?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah read it, went up to Yahweh's house, and spread it before Yahweh.

answers.text: He burned it in the fire
He read it aloud to the people on the wall
He spread it before Yahweh in Yahweh's house
He sent it on to the king of Egypt

questions.text: In his prayer, what did Hezekiah say the gods of the nations really were?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah said they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone.

answers.text: The work of men's hands, wood and stone
Servants of the king of Assyria
Gods who had delivered their lands

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would put in the nose of the king of Assyria?
questions.explanation: Because of his raging and arrogance, Yahweh said, "I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips."

questions.text: How many did Yahweh's angel strike in the camp of the Assyrians that night?
questions.explanation: That night Yahweh's angel struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians.

questions.text: Where did Sennacherib live after he departed and returned?
questions.explanation: Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, returned, and lived at Nineveh.

questions.text: Who struck Sennacherib with the sword while he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god?
questions.explanation: Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword and escaped into the land of Ararat.
